name: Portal Market-Data Sourcing Strategy (YCharts vs Bloomberg-PKL vs SmartX)
description: Andrew-direct directive 2026-05-20 (CEO interview with 0.1.0_DS_MarketIntelligence + the ycharts.com.har 92MB capture). Goal: determine, surface by surface, which portal market-data surfaces currently fed by the manual Bloomberg pkl yang-pipeline could instead be sourced by a daily automated YCharts pull, and which must remain manual Bloomberg pkl -- the end-state is an explicit hybrid. Also evaluates whether model-portfolio performance is better sourced from YCharts /model_portfolios/*, the yang model.pkl, or the SmartX backend. Phase 0 = four parallel domain audits (WS-1 external market data / WS-2 portfolio analytics / WS-3 client-facing data) + an operational-pattern declaration (WS-4) + a live YCharts session test. Phase 1 = CTO synthesis -> migration decision matrix + integration architecture + phased implementation plan (PRD v0.3). Implementation (Phase 2) is charted by v0.3 and gated on the Andrew Q1/Q7 business calls.
phase: Phase 1 COMPLETE -- WS-5 SYNTHESIS SHIPPED. PRD v0.3 (implementation charter) SHIPPED 2026-05-20 (1.0.0_SA_CTO). All four Phase-0 audits + the live-session test consumed. MIGRATION DECISION MATRIX (32 surfaces): 7 YCharts-replaceable + 10 hybrid (YCharts feeds inputs, Opal keeps computation) = YCharts touches 17/32; 6 SmartX-sourced (incl. the model-portfolio performance manual-pkl->SmartX-REST upgrade); 6 proprietary + 1 Bloomberg-pkl-only (Opal model IP -- model_pkl + CMA/SAA workbooks, stay manual); 2 already on FRED (VIX, yield curve). Q4 ANSWERED: SmartX REST API = canonical model-portfolio performance source (model.pkl retained as the proprietary design view). INTEGRATION ARCHITECTURE: YCharts cookie-bundle operational pattern (WS-4) declared; CTO recommendation -- pursue the official YCharts Data API as primary (eliminates the single-session/WAF/capture/ToS risk), session-scrape as fallback. PHASED PLAN: Phase 2A capture-probe + Q1 (TO-A1); Phase 2B SmartX-REST model-perf pull, Q1-INDEPENDENT (TO-B1, co-scopes with SXPL_RESTIN); Phase 2C YCharts integration build, Q1-gated (TO-C1/C2); Phase 2D yang-pipeline cutover (TO-D1). Handed to COO for implementation-TO decomposition.
blocking: None for decomposition -- PRD v0.3 shipped, handed to COO. Phase 2A (TO-A1 capture probe) + Phase 2B (TO-B1 SmartX-REST model-perf pull) are Q1-INDEPENDENT and dispatchable on COO decomposition. Phase 2C (YCharts integration build) GATES on the Andrew Q1 (official API vs session-scrape -- CTO recommends official API) + Q7 (ToS) business calls. Q8 (realized vs design model returns) is a product call gating the TO-B1 portal-wiring step.
